title: Canopus Assistant cloud manifest
description: Fetched by the FOSS assistant-module host when the feature is enabled. Carries ALL product/branding/commercial specifics so none of it is hardcoded in the AGPL repo. The host is generic and renders whatever a manifest describes.

iconEmoji.description: Emoji shown on the badge/FAB when no iconUrl.

badge.description: The initial neutral entry point shown before subscription.

intro.description: Content for the intro/subscribe modal opened from the badge.

checkoutUrl.description: Where the modal sends the user to subscribe (Stripe Checkout entry, opened in a new tab).

manageUrl.description: Stripe customer portal for existing subscribers.

url.description: The chat UI to embed once subscribed + enabled.

origin.description: Exact origin for postMessage validation, e.g. https://assistant.example.com

base.description: Cloud API base the client uses for account/session/billing + the agent WS. The FOSS host does NOT call this; only the iframe does.

allowlist.description: The Polaris API calls the host may execute on the iframe's behalf. Derived from tools/catalog.json 'polaris' blocks. The host also enforces a hardcoded denylist regardless of this list.
